name: DJ Vic
blurb: The flagship booking site for an international DJ. Guests self-route by event — weddings, corporate, clubs — with his remixes and The Vic Fix series a scroll away. The rebuild took its search score from 38 to 92.

name: DJ Rhea
blurb: Ultra-luxury for a DJ who plays live darbuka over her sets. Towering serif display on gold and black, a live showreel, and a booking flow that captures the date, the room and the brief before it ever reaches her inbox.

name: Lloyd’s Pro Sound & Lighting
blurb: Sound, light and music run by one team since 2008. The proof leads — 1,000+ events and a 4.7★ rating — with a dedicated page for every event type and booking a WhatsApp message away.

name: DJ Gags
blurb: “The room never lies.” A photography-led site for a Delhi DJ, producer and remixer, where 26 years and six residencies carry the pitch and an availability check sits above the fold.

name: SNLA · Sapna Naik Landscape Architecture
blurb: Image-first to the edges, so the gardens speak before the words do. A near-navless portfolio for a landscape-architecture studio, with project stories, careers and contact always one click away.

name: Supriya Bopanna
blurb: A calm, editorial home for a psychologist, built around a custom “Perspective” wordmark. Serif type and wide margins set the tone; the writing explains plainly how therapy works and who it’s for.

name: Bengaluru DJs Collective
blurb: A no-agenda room for the city’s DJs — the people behind the flyers, finally in one place. Bold gold-on-black type, recaps of past editions and a simple way in, built to grow a scene rather than sell a booking.

name: Flingit
blurb: Every city has its drink; Bangalore has Flingit. A moody, bilingual site for the beverage and its culture of play — a spot-finder across 230+ outlets, events, rewards and a weekly leaderboard, all behind a proper age gate.
